# BuzzInstaller

> Send & receive files through BuzzHeavier from your desktop, with `BZ://`
> links. Desktop app in Python/PySide6, Android companion in Flutter.

## Attribution

BuzzInstaller is by **MapleSyrupLover** and is licensed **MIT + Attribution**.
If you copy, fork, or use this repository as a reference — including its `BZ://`
link handling — you must credit MapleSyrupLover and link back to:
<https://github.com/MapleSyrupLover/BuzzInstaller>
